GIS.thesis_one_line: Maker of Cheerios and Blue Buffalo pet food, priced for permanent decline at about 11 times earnings, paying a 7.3% dividend while earnings bottom.
kill_criteria: Organic net sales below -2.0% in two consecutive quarters (FY27 guide: "Organic net sales are expected to range between down 1.5 percent and up 0.5 percent."; Q1 FY27 flat).

Annual dividend cut below $2.44 per share, or guided adjusted EPS falling so that the $2.44 dividend exceeds 90% of the adjusted EPS midpoint of the guide "between $3.00 and $3.20 per share" (79% now).
Consolidated net debt (current portion of long-term debt + notes payable + long-term debt less cash, condensed consolidated balance sheet) above 4.5x TTM adjusted EBITDA (about 4.0x at 30 Aug 2026).
FY27 adjusted diluted EPS guidance cut below the current low end of $3.00 ("between $3.00 and $3.20 per share").
Any further non-cash goodwill or brand impairment above $500 million (Blue Buffalo or Progresso flagged in the 10-Q).
key_adverse_facts: FY27 guide: adjusted EPS $3.00-$3.20 vs $3.55 earned in FY26 (down 10-15% constant currency); FY26 adjusted EPS fell 16% and the guide was cut during the year.
Consolidated net debt about $13.2bn, about 4.0x trailing adjusted EBITDA (my build); dividend $2.44 is about 79% of guided adjusted EPS and FY26 free cash flow after dividends was only $311m.
FY26 free cash flow conversion was 85% of adjusted after-tax earnings against a guide of at least 95%.
Q4 FY26 non-cash impairments of $1,750.0m (Pet goodwill $1,500.0m, Nudges/True Chews brands $250.0m) plus a $1,032m Brazil loss; the 10-Q flags Blue Buffalo and Progresso intangibles as at risk.
Q1 FY27: adjusted operating profit -11%, North America Retail profit -15%, Pet profit -12%, pet organic volume -6 points; CEO transition announced 29 Sep 2026 (after the cutoff).
data_conflicts: Triage rejected on negative GAAP margin and a 7% yield read as distress; filings show the loss is non-cash impairment and the yield is covered by free cash flow (about 85% payout), so the triage reading is overturned on price.
The 18 Mar 2026 guide is labelled reaffirmed but the prior range was down 10-15%; no intervening Item 2.02 8-K was found, so the date of the cut is not verified from filings.
b1 earnings yield (-5.0%) and P/E use GAAP trailing loss; adjusted FY27 guided P/E is 10.9x.
GIS.next_earnings_date_basis: estimated from the December pattern (Q2 FY26 on 17 Dec 2025); not confirmed
GIS.confidence_in_thesis: medium: cash yield and implied decline are well covered, but leverage near 4x and a 79% payout leave little room for another miss

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists. Reverse DCF implies about -2.2% a year of free-cash-flow growth for ten years (cost of equity 8.5%); my base is about +2.5%, so the price is below base.

GIS.scenario_basis: Start $33.64; bear NTM adjusted EPS $2.50 at 9.5x with dividend cut to $1.80 after year 1; base $3.40 at 11.5x with $2.44 a year; bull $3.70 at 13x; (exit price + cumulative dividends)/start, annualised, dividends not reinvested.

TSLA.thesis_one_line: Profitable electric-car, battery and services company with $34bn net cash, but its $1.5 trillion price assumes robotaxis and robots succeed on a giant scale.
TSLA.horizon: re-underwrite every 12 months; no position until price or evidence closes the gap
kill_criteria: Automotive gross margin excluding regulatory credits below 14.0% in two consecutive quarters (consolidated automotive segment; Q2 2026 16.3%, update reconciliation table).
Trailing-four-quarter consolidated free cash flow below -$5,000m, or consolidated cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments below $30,000m (now $43,524m).
Trailing-four-quarter total vehicle deliveries below 1.60 million (now 1,753,475 = 497,099 + 418,227 + 358,023 + 480,126).
No unsupervised paid Robotaxi service in any metro outside Texas and Florida by 30 Jun 2027, or any regulator-ordered suspension of unsupervised operation.
Consolidated GAAP operating income below $200m in each of two consecutive quarters (Q2 2026: $398m).
key_adverse_facts: Q2 2026 GAAP operating margin 1.4% (10.8% in Q3 2024); operating income -57% year on year while revenue grew 26%; operating expenses +47%.
Capex guided above $25bn for 2026 (raised from above $20bn); Q2 free cash flow -$1,092m, so 2026 free cash flow is negative.
Q2 GAAP net income $1,114m includes a $1,005m pre-tax SpaceX stake gain and $274m of tax items; excluding them it is about $77m (about $0.02 a share).
Energy gross margin fell to 20.4% from 30.3% on a vendor-cell warranty issue; regulatory credits fell to $146m from $439m.
Benavides Autopilot verdict ($129m compensatory, $200m punitive) under appeal; securities class actions over Autopilot, FSD and Robotaxi; NHTSA, NTSB, SEC and DOJ information requests.
2025 CEO award of about 423.7m restricted shares with $9.82bn unrecognised probable cost and $105.8-$120.4bn contingent; cover shares 3,949.5m vs 3,540m diluted weighted average.
data_conflicts: d4 market cap $1,470bn uses 3,949.5m cover-page shares including unearned CEO restricted stock; diluted EPS uses 3,540m weighted shares, so P/E and market-cap bases differ by about 11%.
Triage quoted 338x trailing P/E on GAAP; TTM GAAP EPS from the update tables is $1.08 (344x at $372.11); non-GAAP TTM EPS is $1.74 (214x).
Tesla gives no numeric earnings guidance; the only numeric forward figure is capex in the 10-K and 10-Q.

ETN.thesis_one_line: Maker of the electrical gear that powers data centers and the grid, growing fast with rising orders, but its price already assumes management's growth targets.
kill_criteria: Organic growth below 10% in any quarter of the second half of 2026 (Q3 guide "Organic growth of 13.5-15.5%"; Q2 actual 14%).
Segment margin below 23.0% in Q3 or Q4 2026 (Q3 guide "Segment margins of 24.6-25.0%"; Q2 actual 23.1%).

Consolidated net debt (short-term debt + current portion + long-term debt less cash and short-term investments, condensed consolidated balance sheet) above 3.5x trailing EBITDA (my build) at 30 Jun 2027; about 3.1x at 30 Jun 2026.
Full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance low end cut below $13.00 (now "between $13.40 and $13.60").
Electrical segment rolling twelve-month book-to-bill below 1.0 (now 1.2) or Electrical Americas rolling orders growth below +10% (now +41%).
key_adverse_facts: Q2 2026 GAAP EPS $2.11 fell 16% year on year (adjusted $3.15 rose 7%); effective tax rate 28.1% vs 17.2%; net interest $201m vs $71m.
Consolidated net debt about $19.9bn (from about $9.1bn at 31 Dec 2025) after Boyd Thermal ($9.55bn) and Ultra PCS ($1.53bn); goodwill and intangibles 162% of equity; buybacks zero in H1 2026.
Organic growth guidance missed in Q3 2025 (7% vs 8-9%) and Q4 2025 (9% vs 10-12%) before beating in Q1 and Q2 2026.
FY26 guided GAAP EPS $10.36-$10.56 was cut twice from $11.57-$12.07; adjusted EPS excludes $1.74 of intangible amortisation (about 13% of adjusted).
Electrical Americas operating margin 27.5%, down about 200 bps year on year; trailing free cash flow about 82% of adjusted earnings vs the 95-100% target.
Mobility separation with Dana is not yet closed (expected Q1 2027) and needs Dana stockholder and regulatory approvals.
data_conflicts: Q4 2025 exhibit dateline reads 26 Feb 2026 while the 8-K (0001551182-26-000002) says the release was issued on 3 Feb 2026.
Triage used 44.9x trailing and 28.5x NTM P/E (GAAP trailing, consensus forward); on guided FY26 adjusted EPS the multiple is 32.6x and on guided GAAP EPS 42.1x.
Prior working file used an enterprise value of $171bn (market cap only); the correct consolidated enterprise value including $19.9bn net debt is $190.8bn.
